human_pressure.one_screen_brief: As an Ailuros user, I can pass a v0.3 audit-package directory to the CLI and receive a deterministic JSON result telling me whether the package is valid and whether the run passes, requires review, or fails governance audit.
human_pressure.why_now: v0.3 already exports 7-file audit packages. The next useful core step is a deterministic v1.5-style post-run validator without moving into HTTP ingestion, runtime blocking, dashboard, auth, or reference-app coupling.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally scoped to application-agnostic Ailuros core.
Evidence before runtime control; deterministic decisions over model judgment.
red_lines: No runtime blocking or live ingestion.
No Clarify, EverRun, radarCreation, browser, UI, or domain-specific coupling in src/ailuros.

machine_core.goal: Implement a minimal audit-package validation loop for Ailuros core: given a v0.3 audit package directory, load it, validate its structure and run consistency, derive a deterministic post-run audit decision, and expose it through a CLI command.
red_lines: Do not add HTTP API endpoints.
Do not add runtime blocking or live ingestion.
Do not add complex policy DSL.
Do not add Clarify/EverRun/radarCreation-specific models to src/ailuros.
Do not change existing v0.3 audit-package export behavior except where strictly necessary to keep tests passing.
contracts: 7 required files: manifest.json, run.json, timeline.jsonl, decisions.json, evaluations.json, regressions.json, summary.md
Decision precedence: invalid/block -> FAIL, review -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, otherwise PASS
CLI command: python -m ailuros validate-package <package_dir> prints JSON to stdout
CLI exits non-zero for FAIL from invalid package structure or parse/consistency errors
failure_semantics: Missing file -> valid=false, decision=FAIL, reason naming the missing file
Typed exceptions or structured error records; avoid raw tracebacks in normal CLI output
steps: Add an application-agnostic package loader that accepts a filesystem directory path.
Validate that all 7 v0.3 audit-package files exist.
Parse JSON files with clear deterministic errors on malformed JSON.
Parse timeline.jsonl line by line with deterministic errors on malformed JSONL, including line number where practical.
Check run_id consistency across package records where run_id is present.
Return a structured validation result with valid:boolean, decision:string, and reasons:list[str].
Derive decision FAIL when package structure is invalid, JSON/JSONL is malformed, run_id consistency fails, or blocking governance decision present.
Derive decision REVIEW_REQUIRED when at least one require_review/review decision is present and no blocking/failing condition.
Derive decision PASS when the package is valid and no block/review condition exists.
Expose a CLI command that prints JSON to stdout: python -m ailuros validate-package <package_dir>.
The CLI must exit non-zero for FAIL; may exit zero for PASS and REVIEW_REQUIRED.
acceptance: A valid v0.3 audit package returns valid=true and decision=PASS when no block/review evidence exists.
A package missing any required file returns valid=false and decision=FAIL with a reason naming the missing file.
Malformed JSON in any JSON file returns valid=false and decision=FAIL.
Malformed JSONL in timeline.jsonl returns valid=false and decision=FAIL.
Mismatched run_id across package files/events returns valid=false and decision=FAIL.
A package containing a block/blocking decision returns decision=FAIL.
A package containing require_review/review and no block returns decision=REVIEW_REQUIRED.
The implementation does not introduce reference-app imports or domain-specific concepts into src/ailuros.
The new CLI command is covered by tests or existing CLI test style.

must_check: The implementation is application-agnostic and respects the src/ailuros core boundary.
The package validator requires exactly the documented v0.3 audit-package files.
The CLI command emits deterministic JSON with valid, decision, and reasons fields.
Invalid structure, malformed JSON/JSONL, and run_id mismatch are rejected deterministically.
Decision precedence is correct: invalid/block -> FAIL, review -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, otherwise PASS.
Tests cover valid, missing file, malformed JSON, malformed JSONL, run_id mismatch, block decision, and review decision cases.
No forbidden paths or generated junk directories are modified.
All validation commands listed in this pack are run and reported honestly.
reject_if: The change adds HTTP API, dashboard, auth/session, runtime blocking, live ingestion, or policy DSL work.
The change imports Clarify, EverRun, radarCreation, browser, UI, refund, or other domain-specific concepts into src/ailuros core.
The CLI prints human-only text instead of machine-readable JSON for normal results.
Malformed package files are ignored or downgraded to warnings.
Decision logic is model/LLM-dependent or non-deterministic.
Existing validation commands are removed, weakened, or skipped without explicit evidence.
The implementation changes unrelated release behavior or broad architecture documents to make the pack pass.
